text: assāti . no hetaṃ bhante . evaṃ passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmiṃpi nibbindati .pe. jivhāyapi nibbindati .pe. manasmiṃpi nibbindati nibbindaṃ virajjati virāgā vimuccati . vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti . khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātīti . pañcamaṃ . [159] saññojaniye ca bhikkhave dhamme desissāmi saññojanañca taṃ suṇātha . katame ca bhikkhave saññojaniyā dhammā katamañca saññojanaṃ . cakkhuṃ bhikkhave saññojaniyo dhammo yo tattha chandarāgo taṃ tattha saññojanaṃ .pe. jivhā
